text: Good morning! How are you today? It has been a while since we last talked.
My name is Amina. I just moved to this neighborhood and I work as a teacher at the local school.
Excuse me, how do I get to the bus station from here? Is it within walking distance?
How much for these tomatoes? That is a bit expensive. Can you lower the price if I buy two baskets?
I would like a plate of rice with beans and some vegetables, please. And a glass of water.
The rains are late this year. The farmers are worried, but the sky looks promising this afternoon.
Are you free on Saturday? We could meet for tea in the afternoon and catch up properly.
Do you know what time it is? I think I am late for my meeting and my phone has run out of battery.
Thank you so much for your help today. I really appreciate it. Please greet your family for me.
It was lovely seeing you. Take care of yourself, and let's not wait so long to meet again.
